subject: vjust in geom_text calls hjust instead

messages.author: 13ff1921a4b26560
messages.subject: vjust in geom_text calls hjust instead
parts:
Hi,
when I am trying to set the slider for Vjust in a geom_text() layer,
it calls to hjust instead of vjust which can be confirmed by checking
'view call' after changing the Vjust value.
I see the same behavior in Deducer_0.4-4 and 0.4-5
Thanks,
Allan

R version 2.13.1 i386-pc-mingw32/i386 (32-bit) Deducer_0.4-4
ggplot2_0.8.9

# this is the code I get from adjusting sliders labeled Hjust and
Vjust
ggplot() +
geom_text(aes(x = cty,y = hwy,label = cty),data=mpg,hjust =
0.7451,hjust = 0.246,parse = FALSE)
